candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (DependencyUnavailable) in inventory, propagating 503 from /v1/reservations and 502 from /v1/orders and /v1/checkout across all correlated requests.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs absent; root cause of the redis timeout (saturation vs network) not established.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in inventory cascading to order and gateway 502s; logs and metrics confirm ~2s checkout failures. Topology supports gateway->order->inventory->redis path. Redis-internal cause remains unverified.
